name: native-narration-rides-the-result
description: SPEC.md 6.0, 6.2: a V1 provider carries narration as a field on the structured result - the SAY line's native twin - and it is screened and voiced through the same loop seam the text protocol uses, because adopting native calls changes how a choice is read, not what the agent is. Model narration takes precedence over the tool's declared Starting template on the native path exactly as on the text path.
